title: Where Is the RDR2 Next-Gen Upgrade?

beats.text: Red Dead Redemption 2 turns eight years old this month.
And on PS5 and Xbox Series X, it is still stuck at thirty frames per second.
So where is the next-gen upgrade? Here's what we actually know.
Last December, Rockstar gave the original Red Dead Redemption a proper current-gen release. Sixty FPS. 4K. HDR.
Fans assumed Arthur Morgan was next. Instead... silence.
Insider NateTheHate says the upgrade is real, and was planned for this year. But he has no update on timing.
Another insider, Kiwi Talkz, claims it could slip all the way to late 2027.
And a June report says it may already be finished... and Rockstar is simply sitting on it.
Why? GTA Six. It launches this November, and Rockstar won't let anything steal that spotlight.
Until then, Red Dead Online's Halloween event is live through November second, with four times rewards on Strange Tales of the West.
Would you buy RDR2 again for sixty FPS? Tell me in the comments.
